Why does our agent open no ports on your server? 🔒

Most tools need a way in: a web port for the panel, or SSH keys stored on someone else's platform.

YourPanel flips it: a small Go agent on your server connects OUT to the panel over a secure WebSocket. Nothing listens for incoming connections, the panel never holds an SSH key, and every action goes into a tamper-evident audit log.
